map.name: Krennack
map.setting: a cave town of miners under a mountain
map.trouble: Urgrubb and his Ogres have come up out of the deep tunnels and seized the Great Lift, cutting Krennack off from the surface.

guard_bark.specifics: Stobb, the guard at the lift lever by the Pit Office, before and after the Great Lift is retaken.

first.speaker: Stobb
first.text: Where have you been? The Foreman has been asking for you all morning! You'd best get over to the Pit Office if you ever want to see the Great Lift running again. The Ogres won't leave by themselves.

again.speaker: Stobb
again.text: Get away from that lift lever, lad! Unless you WANT to go down the hard way!

later.speaker: Stobb
later.text: Hey, you should get a helmet before you go back down the Great Lift.

bounty_offer.specifics: Warden Toskel must by order of the Mining Council evict a Troll squatting in the old Counting House, and would rather anyone else did it.

offer.speaker: Toskel
offer.text:
Ahem. You there, stranger. The Mining Council has ordered that the Troll squatting in the old Counting House be evicted at once. As Warden, the duty falls to me.

I have the notice right here, signed and sealed. But that Troll is the biggest, smelliest lout ever to set foot in Krennack! Ever since the Ogres took the Great Lift, every brute in the mountain thinks he can just move in!

The Counting House is at the east end of town. Get that Troll out of there, by whatever means you like, and the Council will see you rewarded.

reminder.speaker: Toskel
reminder.text: It's not every day we get a Troll for a neighbor.

completion.speaker: Toskel
completion.text:
Excellent work! The Counting House is fit for honest folk again, and I never had to set one foot inside!

On behalf of the Mining Council, I present you with this shield. Wear it with pride!

journal.text: Evict the Troll squatting in the old Counting House.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Fennick the prospector cannot find a scrap of ore without his Singing Pick, which the Imps snatched from his hands.

offer.speaker: Fennick
offer.text:
Gone! My Singing Pick is gone! Those wretched Imps snatched it right out of my hands while I was eating my lunch!

Without that pick I couldn't find gold in a goldsmith's shop! I'm ruined!

The Imps have a nest down the old West Shaft. Will you get my pick back for me, young sir?

refusal.speaker: Fennick
refusal.text: You've made up your mind then. Sorry the Imps aren't in the habit of giving things back.

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: One of the cart boys heard singing from the Imp nest. You just have to follow it!

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: My pick! Listen to her sing! I never thought I'd hear that sweet sound again! Here, take this gold, with an old man's thanks!

after.speaker: Fennick
after.text: Thanks again for helping a poor broke old digger.

journal.text: Imps have stolen Fennick's Singing Pick -- hunt them down and bring it back!

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Imps have stolen Fennick's Singing Pick -- hunt them down and bring it back!

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: Old Gant with a pointer, Mirri worrying about the Ogres, Dolla in a fright.

rumour1.speaker: Gant
rumour1.text: Foreman Brakkus is over at the Pit Office. He keeps the keys to every shaft in Krennack.

rumour2.speaker: Mirri
rumour2.text: How can a town of miners fight off Ogres? This is a disaster! What will become of us?

rumour3.speaker: Dolla
rumour3.text: Oh No! An Ogre! Hide the gold!

shop_greeting.specifics: Tobbs of the Broken Pick inn, Hurlo the smith, Zilva the cross old witch of the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Tobbs
inn.text: You look like you've been down the shafts too long, friend.

arms.speaker: Hurlo
arms.text: Are you a new hire for the mines?

magic.speaker: Zilva
magic.text: Word gets around. Get out, before I hex the beard off your chin!

two_givers.specifics: Foreman Brakkus wants the Shift Bell back from the Ogres so his men can go home. Jory must have Ma's Enchanted Rolling Pin back on its hook before she comes home tonight, and pays with Pa's sword.

offer_a.speaker: Brakkus
offer_a.text:
It's a disgrace! The Ogres have carried off the Shift Bell!

Without that bell nobody knows when a shift is over. Half my men haven't come up for supper in days, and their wives are ready to skin me alive!

The brutes took it down to their camp below the Great Lift. Bring the bell back to the Pit Office and I'll see you're paid.

offer_b.speaker: Jory
offer_b.text:
Hey! You! C'mere a second!

I'm in big trouble. I borrowed Ma's Enchanted Rolling Pin to swat Bats down the old East Shaft, and... well... I dropped it down a crack.

Ma comes home tonight! If that pin isn't on its hook when she walks in, I'm a dead man! Fetch it for me and I'll give you Pa's old sword. He'll never notice it's gone!

outcome_a.speaker: Brakkus
outcome_a.text:
The Shift Bell! Ring it! Ring it loud! Now my men can finally go home and eat!

Thank you, lad. Here's 100 gold from the company strongbox. Spend it well!

outcome_b.speaker: Jory
outcome_b.text:
Ma's pin! Not a dent on it! Oh, you saved my hide, stranger!

Here's Pa's sword, like I promised. If anybody asks, you found it.

journal_a.text: Return the stolen Shift Bell to Foreman Brakkus at the Pit Office.

journal_b.text: Find Ma's Enchanted Rolling Pin for Jory.

rescue.specifics: Granny Vell's pet mole Duggles dug his way into the Ogre camp under the Great Lift.

plea.speaker: Vell
plea.text:
Help! Oh, somebody help me! My Duggles dug his way right into the Ogre camp under the Great Lift!

Those brutes will eat anything that wriggles! My sweet little mole will end up in an Ogre's stew pot!

Please, kind stranger, find my Duggles and bring him home to me!

reminder.speaker: Vell
reminder.text: By the way, Duggles always squeaks when he's frightened...

found.speaker: Duggles
found.text: Salutations, kind sir! I am most relieved you have come at long last!

completion.speaker: Vell
completion.text:
Duggles! My precious Duggles! You're home, you're home!

Bless you, kind stranger. Please accept this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Bring Granny Vell's pet mole home from the Ogre camp.

main_opening.specifics: A townsman points the player to Foreman Brakkus at the Pit Office, who sends him down the old service tunnel after Urgrubb's Ogres at the Great Lift.

herald.speaker: Gant
herald.text: Those Ogres never would have taken the Great Lift if Foreman Brakkus had been on the lever! Go and find him at the Pit Office.

opening.speaker: Brakkus
opening.text:
Ah, there you are! Corvane said you'd be along. Good. We need you, lad.

Urgrubb and his Ogres came up out of the deep tunnels and seized the Great Lift! We can't get ore up or food down, and the whole town is going hungry!

Take this key. It opens the old service tunnel at the south end of the Pit. Get down to the Great Lift and drive Urgrubb out. Krennack is counting on you!

reminder.speaker: Brakkus
reminder.text: Oi! Hello!? This is a mine office, not an inn. Shouldn't you be at the Lift?

journal.text: Foreman Brakkus has given you the service tunnel key, but Urgrubb's Ogres still hold the Great Lift. Maybe the old tunnel is another way down...
